diagram_math_checks.objects: S, G, A(s), V, W, q_W, m
diagram_math_checks.check: Definition lines 33–37 gives V:S→R and q for a∈A(s); the SSP supplier Definition makes each A(s) nonempty finite and P a transition law on S. Thus the saved table W has the same domain, q_W(s,·):A(s)→R, and m is attained by the finite-maximum supplier. The figure neither changes the state/action domains nor adds a policy assumption.

Definition line 33 supplies starts in S_0⊂S\G and cap L. Setting k=0, testing s∈G or k=L before each decision, and incrementing k by one after each completed decision implements at most L decisions and immediate termination on a reached goal. The yes edge goes to trial end; only the no edge reaches the backup sequence.

Definition lines 35–37 explicitly computes action values and uses the pre-backup table for the maximum. Saving W←V once and using q_W and the same m in both draw and backup reproduces this ordering; fresh uniform draw is among all actions attaining m, not among arbitrary actions.

Definition line 37 executes the action and observes next state before updating V(s). Figure keeps s fixed through execute and backup; only the subsequent node assigns s←s′. The backup changes V(s) alone, retaining every other entry. The next observed state lies in S by the SSP/MDP transition law.

Definition lines 33 and 37 set initial goal values to zero and retain V when selecting the next supplied start. The stop test prevents a goal backup, so induction over decisions preserves V(g)=0. Both trial-end and new-start boxes explicitly retain V; only k and s reset.

Native standalone crop shows 8 nodes and 9 directed edges: start→stop→compute→choose→execute→backup→advance; advance→stop closes the left loop; stop→trial-end and trial-end→start close the right loop. Stop has two incoming/two outgoing arrows. No graph-cycle syntax, crossing ambiguity, open/closed endpoint claims, or convergence edge is present.

No proof is supplied or altered for this algorithm. The complete original Definition remains unchanged and independently specifies every operation; added prose justifies the diagram directly from it. The figure is expository and asserts no convergence guarantee.
